hero.title: Websites, campaigns and brands that bring in
hero.subtitle: LYNE helps companies and brands become the ones people choose: websites, SEO, advertising and content, with clear follow-up and numbers you can read.

sections.servicesText: Every engagement starts from a business goal. Website, advertising and content work together.
sections.closingTitle: Tell us what you want to grow.
sections.closingText: A 30-minute call is enough to see if we are the right studio. Reply within one business day.

1.title: Listen
1.text: Your market, your customers, what blocks you today. We start from facts, not a ready-made offer.

2.title: Frame
2.text: A short plan: priorities, budget, metrics. You know what will ship, and what will not.

3.title: Produce
3.text: Design, development, campaigns, content. A tight team, visible checkpoints.

4.title: Measure
4.text: Traffic, enquiries, sales. We reinforce what works and stop what does not help.

footer.blurb: An international digital marketing studio. Websites, acquisition and brands for companies that want to grow anywhere.
footer.newsletterText: An occasional useful email, without aggressive sequences.
